rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a preference or liking for one option over others.

example.english: My preference for tea is for lighter flavours.
example.traditional: 我對茶嘅偏好比較清淡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 caa4 ge3 pin1 hou3 bei2 gaau3 cing1 daam6

rows.note: Use this for someone’s general likes or personal tastes, especially in more neutral or formal wording.

example.english: My preference is pretty simple: I listen to classical music whenever I have time.
example.traditional: 我嘅喜好比較簡單，得閒就聽古典音樂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 hei2 hou3 bei2 gaau3 gaan2 daan1 dak1 haan4 zau6 teng1 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6

rows.note: Use this when the preference means the option someone would choose first.

example.english: This restaurant is my first preference for lunch.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳係我食午飯嘅首選。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai6 ngo5 sik6 ng5 faan6 ge3 sau2 syun2

rows.note: Use this for preferences in food, drink, entertainment, or other matters of taste.

example.english: My preference is for less sweetness, so no sugar in the milk tea, please.
example.traditional: 我嘅口味偏向少甜，奶茶唔該走糖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 hau2 mei6 pin1 hoeng3 siu2 tim4 naai5 caa4 m4 goi1 zau2 tong4
